variants.specifics: Brackenford: Wenna, the miller's widow, wants back her husband's enchanted gloves, taken from the mill by the Urchins of the old barrow.

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text:
While I mind the mill by myself, there's another job I can't get to.

Those Urchins crept in at night and ran off with my husband's enchanted gloves. Their burrow is in the old barrow east of the ford.

Will you bring the gloves back to me, kind sir, and give those little pests a good fright?

refusal.speaker: Wenna
refusal.text: Well! I'll just have to manage on my own, as always.

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text:
The gloves! You got them back! Wonderful!

So the Urchins have a whole den down there? That's bad news for every house by the ford, but there's no time to fret over it. Halvard has been asking for you at the Moot Hall.

Here, take this for your trouble!

after.speaker: Wenna
after.text: Thank you again! Those gloves stay locked up from now on.

journal.text: Recover Wenna's enchanted gloves from the Urchins in the barrow.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Wenna's enchanted gloves from the Urchins in the barrow.

variants.specifics: Khelm: Gundra the smith's magic pickaxe was dragged off by Imps down a hole they dug under her forge.

offer.speaker: Gundra
offer.text:
Oh, please help, kind stranger! The Imps have dug up through my floor and my magic pickaxe is gone, dragged off down their hole under the forge!

Will you go down there and get it back for me?

refusal.speaker: Gundra
refusal.text: Oh... Then I suppose my pickaxe is lost for good.

reminder.speaker: Gundra
reminder.text: Keep whatever else the Imps have stashed down there! Only bring me my pickaxe!

completion.speaker: Gundra
completion.text:
My pickaxe! Oh, you found it! What can I possibly give you for this?!

Eh, what's that? A great big heap of gold? Well... if you insist, here's a little something for your trouble.

journal.text: Recover Gundra's magic pickaxe from the Imp tunnels under Khelm.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Gundra's magic pickaxe from the Imp tunnels under Khelm.

variants.specifics: Kesh: Yselda the healer wants the Boots of Speed that Pothar the cobbler was making her, from his shack in the reeds where the Trolls got him.

offer.speaker: Yselda
offer.text:
Pothar the cobbler was making me a pair of Boots of Speed, and that was a long while ago. They ought to have been done and brought up to my door weeks back.

His shack is out in the reeds to the north, where the Trolls have been prowling. Will you go out there and fetch my Boots?

refusal.speaker: Yselda
refusal.text: Oh. Then I'll just have to wait a while longer for them.

reminder.speaker: Yselda
reminder.text: Find Pothar and bring those Boots to me -- no matter what! Keep to the planks out there. Nasty things lurk under the water!

completion.speaker: Yselda
completion.text:
My Boots of Speed! Wonderful!

So the Trolls got poor Pothar after all, just as I feared. He was a dear old fool, but there's no time now for weeping. Take this Ankh, and go see Mayor Ottrick -- he has been asking for you.

Good luck, stranger!

after.speaker: Yselda
after.text: Thanks again for bringing back my Boots!

journal.text: Retrieve the Boots of Speed from Pothar's shack for Yselda.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Retrieve the Boots of Speed from Pothar's shack for Yselda.

variants.specifics: Castle Vorne: Priestess Ombrel lost the Lantern of Warding to Imps out of the Gloamwood and asks the player to bring it back.

offer.speaker: Priestess Ombrel
offer.text: Hail, stranger! Thank goodness you have come, for our need is very great. A pack of Imps swarmed out of the Gloamwood last night and stole the Lantern of Warding from my altar! Will you hunt down the little thieves in the woods to the south and bring back the holy lantern quickly?

refusal.speaker: Priestess Ombrel
refusal.text: Oh.... Then I must pray for some other hero to come along.

reminder.speaker: Priestess Ombrel
reminder.text: Find the Lantern, quickly! Do not delay! For if it falls into Grashnak's hands, that brute will snuff it out for good, I fear!

completion.speaker: Priestess Ombrel
completion.text:
Well done! The Lantern is home, and I am forever in your debt! Now that it burns again, Grashnak and his filthy Ogres will never set foot inside our walls!

Take these potions and this spell book. You will need them... and soon, I suspect.

after.speaker: Priestess Ombrel
after.text: Thanks once more for all you've done.

journal.text: Recover the Lantern of Warding from the Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover the Lantern of Warding from the Imps.

variants.specifics: Varn: Father Dunstal, Varn's priest: the Imps of the marsh stole his amulet from the chapel.

offer.speaker: Father Dunstal
offer.text:
Ah, the brave Adventurer Odwald promised us! Welcome to Varn!

Those Imps out in the reed marsh have lost their wits. My amulet is gone -- they snatched it right out of the chapel! A fisherman went rowing after them and still hasn't come back.

The marsh lies west of here. Would you fetch my amulet from the Imps? I'll be at the chapel by the shore when you're done.

refusal.speaker: Father Dunstal
refusal.text: Very well. I shall pray for someone with more courage.

reminder.speaker: Father Dunstal
reminder.text: Bolder and bolder, those Imps. Wicked creatures!

completion.speaker: Father Dunstal
completion.text:
Bless you, you found my amulet! For such courage the whole village is in your debt.

Mayor Ostrin is waiting on the long pier, so buy what you need in the shops and hurry to him. And here is a small gift from all of us.

after.speaker: Father Dunstal
after.text: My blessing is all I have left to give. Mayor Ostrin is still out on the long pier waiting for you.

journal.text: Recover Father Dunstal's amulet from the Imps of the marsh.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Father Dunstal's amulet from the Imps of the marsh.

variants.specifics: Quorra: Magister Fennick of the Observatory has lost his Star Lens to the Spiders' nest under the hill.

offer.speaker: Magister Fennick
offer.text:
Wretched crawling vermin! The Spiders came up from under the hill and they have already spun their filth over half the Observatory!

I am Magister Fennick. My Star Lens is gone from its stand. I suspect it was hauled off into the Spiders' nest below us.

Would you be willing to go down and bring it back up to me? I would gladly part with a treasure from my own cabinet in return.

refusal.speaker: Magister Fennick
refusal.text: A pity. I had thought better of you.

reminder.speaker: Magister Fennick
reminder.text: Is there any sign of my Lens? Oh my, those brutes may have broken it by now.

completion.speaker: Magister Fennick
completion.text:
My Star Lens! At last the heavens are mine again.

It seems the Spiders were nothing to you. You may have the makings of a scholar after all. Hmmm... Perhaps.

Take this Ankh from my cabinet. Carry it into the Ossuary when you go after Malgrith. We shall all need you alive before this is done.

after.speaker: Magister Fennick
after.text: Go carefully, and keep the Ankh about you.

journal.text: Recover Magister Fennick's Star Lens from the Spiders' nest.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Magister Fennick's Star Lens from the Spiders' nest.

variants.specifics: Fort Skarrow: Brisa's brother's spyglass was snatched by the Urchins, who ran off to the old quarry.

offer.speaker: Brisa
offer.text:
My brother's spyglass is gone, the Urchins snatched it! He's due back from patrol any minute, and he'll never forgive me!

They scurried off toward the old quarry, kind sir, I saw them. Please help!

Could you bring it home to us? Would you?

refusal.speaker: Brisa
refusal.text: Oh.... Then I'll just have to tell him it's gone.

reminder.speaker: Brisa
reminder.text: He'll be back any time now! Oh, please hurry!

completion.speaker: Brisa
completion.text: My brother's spyglass, safe and sound! You're wonderful! This is for you, for all your trouble!

after.speaker: Brisa
after.text: Thank you again! You're too kind!

journal.text: Bring Brisa's spyglass back from the Urchins at the old quarry.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Bring Brisa's spyglass back from the Urchins at the old quarry.

variants.specifics: Vulkir: Old Muldo the smith cannot work his forge since the Cinder Gang stole his fire gloves.

offer.speaker: Muldo
offer.text:
Aaaagh! Back! Don't hurt me!

Huh. Just a traveler?! My nerves are in pieces. Still, you don't look like those rotten thieves of the Cinder Gang who took my fire gloves! I can't go near my forge without them.

Fetch them back and you'll have saved an old man's trade. Will you do it?

refusal.speaker: Muldo
refusal.text: Oh.... I see. Well, I won't keep you then.

reminder.speaker: Muldo
reminder.text: Got my gloves back?! No?.... Well, that gang hides out in the old quarry west of town.

completion.speaker: Muldo
completion.text: You found my gloves! Bless you, bless you! Now take this spellbook along with my thanks. Everything I ever learned about fire is written in it. Any traveler would be glad of it.

after.speaker: Muldo
after.text: A hundred thanks for my gloves! The forge is roaring again!

journal.text: Recover Muldo's fire gloves from the Cinder Gang.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Muldo's fire gloves from the Cinder Gang.

variants.specifics: Pellamar: Orla the healer lost her healing staff to Urchins and giant bats from the caves east of town.

offer.speaker: Orla
offer.text:
Where have you been all this time!? Something terrible has happened!

Thieving Urchins and giant bats from the caves east of town have broken into my house. They made off with my healing staff, and now the sick of Pellamar go without!

Please, kind sir! Will you get my staff back from those vermin? I will see you well paid.

This key opens the gate in front of the caves. The Urchins' den lies somewhere beyond it.

Take this potion as well, it may come in handy.

refusal.speaker: Orla
refusal.text: Then the sick must suffer, I suppose! I'll find someone with more heart.

reminder.speaker: Orla
reminder.text: Come back with my staff and I'll pay you what I promised.

completion.speaker: Orla
completion.text:
My staff! You've brought it back! Bless you!

Mayor Corvane was here asking for you while you were off in those caves. You'll find him waiting at the Town Hall -- across the square.

Here is some gold for your trouble before you go.

after.speaker: Orla
after.text: Mayor Corvane is an honest man. You'd do well to heed him.

journal.text: Drive the Urchins from the caves east of town. Recover Orla's healing staff.

variants.specifics: Wendrel: Ethra, the miller's widow, needs her magic amulet back from the Urchins to turn her son Dobbin back from a chicken.

offer.speaker: Ethra
offer.text:
Stranger! Oh, please, you must help me! Something dreadful has happened to my son!

The raiders came through last night with an Ogre shaman, and a wicked spell of his turned my poor Dobbin into a chicken! My magic amulet would undo it. But the Urchins took it off to their den east of the stream, and if I go after it the cat will get him!

Bring my amulet back to me, will you? There's good pay in it for you.

refusal.speaker: Ethra
refusal.text: A chicken, then! Leave my poor boy a chicken, see if I care!

reminder.speaker: Ethra
reminder.text: Dobbin needs that amulet! What's keeping you?

completion.speaker: Ethra
completion.text: Bless you, oh, bless you! I'll never be able to pay you back properly... Here, a token of my appreciation, take it!

after.speaker: Ethra
after.text: Dobbin and I thank you again!

journal.text: Get Ethra's magic amulet back from the Urchin den east of Wendrel.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Get Ethra's magic amulet back from the Urchin den east of Wendrel.
